title: Chapter 1060: 11 Conditions Of The Eye Of Myriad Laws (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3

Chapter 1060: 11 Conditions Of The Eye Of Myriad Laws (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3

Chapter 1060: Chapter 11 Conditions of the Eye of Myriad Laws (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_3

If Lin Yuan independently created an evolution pathway, and merely in the Path Splitting Realm, managed to develop a branch of this pathway—could it be?

The Eye of Myriad Laws held great hope for Lin Yuan’s potential, which is why it actively initiated conversation and even helped to ‘clarify’ his doubts.

“It was merely luck,” Lin Yuan detected the lingering tone in the voice of the Eye of Myriad Laws and immediately shook his head in response.

“Creating an evolution pathway isn’t about mere luck, especially the pathway you’ve created. Each of its branches possesses Chaos Realm-level potential…”

The Eye of Myriad Laws said.

Branches with Chaos Realm-level potential? What then must the primary path of Lin Yuan’s pathway hold?

Lin Yuan listened quietly.

Before an entity like the Eye of Myriad Laws, there was no need to feign excessive humility. Its recognition and praise were clear evidence that one was deserving of it.

“Alright, let’s get to the main matter at hand.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws gazed at Lin Yuan and said, “If you wish to use my Pavilion of Myriad Laws to propagate your evolution pathway, that’s fine, but it comes with conditions.”

“Please, go ahead.”

Lin Yuan was not surprised in the slightest.

During the era of human civilization within the universe, utilizing the power of humanity to spread one’s evolution pathway was only possible because Lin Yuan himself was a citizen of humanity.

But for those Ancient Gods deep within the stars beyond human civilization who sought to spread their evolution pathways among humanity, they would undoubtedly face suppression and containment.

Lin Yuan had no direct ties to the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion. If he wished to leverage their power to disseminate the branches of his evolution pathways and prepare for his future attempt to ascend to the Thirteenth Layer, he would certainly need to pay the price.

“It’s quite simple.”

“For now, you need not concern yourself. After you achieve the state of Chaos Realm Perfection, then every ten Cosmic Eras you must perform a task for my Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws stated.

“Perform one task every ten Cosmic Eras?”

Lin Yuan looked back at the Eye of Myriad Laws.

The prerequisite for this condition was Lin Yuan first attaining Chaos Realm Perfection.

If other Path Splitting Realm beings—or cultivators even at Master Realm or Chaos Venerable status—heard this, they would undoubtedly agree without hesitation.

After all, even for Chaos Venerables, the certainty of cultivating to Chaos Realm Perfection was far from assured.

Thus, the condition proposed by the Eye of Myriad Laws was not particularly restrictive.

However, for Lin Yuan?

With the aid of Against-Heaven’s Understanding and the Myriad Realms Gate, Lin Yuan wasn’t entirely certain he could ascend to the Thirteenth Layer, but Chaos Realm Perfection? That seemed feasible—it was merely a matter of time.

At present, Lin Yuan merely needed to wait for his physical body and soul to grow to their peak before he could step into the Master Realm.

As for breaking through from the Master Realm to the Chaos Realm, Lin Yuan had already met most of the myriad requirements, aided further by the amplifying effects of the rules comprehension bestowed by that Source World.

For Lin Yuan, stepping into the Chaos Realm was not particularly challenging.

As for achieving Chaos Realm Perfection? It simply involved using Chaos Rules as the foundation to evolve the corresponding Dao of Chaos, and Lin Yuan had already identified specific directions within the Source World.

Simply put, Lin Yuan’s path from Path Splitting Realm to Chaos Realm Perfection was already foreseeable.

Therefore.

The condition proposed by the Eye of Myriad Laws was, in truth, not particularly beneficial to Lin Yuan.

“Every ten Cosmic Eras, for the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion? Any task at all?”

Lin Yuan asked inquisitively.

What if the Pavilion required him to seek death or actively enter perilous areas—would he have to comply?

“Rest assured, you won’t be asked to undertake tasks without confidence in their success, and appropriate compensation will also be provided.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws replied.

“Furthermore, should you fail a task, there will be no coercion to continue attempting it.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws added.

Should Lin Yuan genuinely reach the state of Chaos Realm Perfection, the Eye of Myriad Laws would not wish to press him excessively.

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan began to weigh his options.

First of all, the promise of compensation for completing tasks satisfied Lin Yuan slightly—he was not afraid of effort but despised labor without reward.

Additionally, if he failed a mission and it became evident that success was unattainable, no further force would be exerted upon him. This reassured Lin Yuan somewhat.

The worst consequence of failing a task might simply be losing a Primordial Spirit, a price Lin Yuan was fully able to bear.

And most crucially, the Eye of Myriad Laws’ requirement was merely one task every ten Cosmic Eras.

From Lin Yuan’s birth until now, even if he included all accumulated time from his travels across various worlds, his total lifespan fell short of ten thousand years. Ten Cosmic Eras were far too long for Lin Yuan to fully comprehend.

“Agreed.”

After careful consideration, Lin Yuan nodded.

“Very well.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws nodded slightly.

Simply assisting Lin Yuan in propagating his evolution pathway guaranteed the future commitment of someone on the brink of Chaos Realm Perfection. Regardless of circumstances, this was a transaction the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion would not lose.

“Let’s begin.”

As the Eye of Myriad Laws spoke, a golden scroll materialized before it.

The scroll’s surface displayed numerous symbols. Though Lin Yuan could not recognize the script, glancing at it immediately revealed the underlying meaning.

It was precisely the conditions the Eye of Myriad Laws had outlined moments earlier.

The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion was to aid Lin Yuan in propagating his evolution pathway, but in exchange, once Lin Yuan attained Chaos Realm Perfection, he would perform one task every ten Cosmic Eras for them.

The scroll’s contents provided strict limitations, mentioning the prohibition of coercion as well as the requirement to offer compensation.

Lin Yuan studied the scroll meticulously several times.

“If there are no issues, release a wisp of soul aura and imprint it upon the scroll.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws continued.

The golden scroll’s stipulated conditions were unbreakable.

Even someone at Chaos Realm Perfection who dared transgress them would suffer severe injury and instantly lose all prospects of reaching the Thirteenth Layer.

Thus, as long as Lin Yuan was willing to imprint a wisp of his soul aura upon the scroll, the Eye of Myriad Laws would be assured.

“Wait.”

Lin Yuan hesitated momentarily. “What limitations apply to the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion’s assistance in propagating my evolution pathways? Would it be restricted to a single pathway?”

If the assistance was limited merely to the propagation of his Life and Death Martial Dao evolution pathway, then the conditions on the scroll seemed rather unfavorable.

A single martial pathway could, at best, foster the emergence of one Twelfth-Layer ultimate being, which wouldn’t establish significant fixed anchors for Lin Yuan’s Dao markers.

“Naturally, it wouldn’t be just one.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws shook its head, stating that if it were a single pathway, the limitation would have been plainly marked on the scroll.

“If your realm advances further and you develop additional branches of evolution pathways, the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion can also propagate them.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws added.

“That’s good.”

Lin Yuan finally felt reassured. “There’s no need to wait for the future—I already have several evolution pathway branches.”

“Oh?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan curiously.

Additional evolution pathway branches?

Several?
